title: Original application registry configuration string write, value delete and close

0x546824.name: ADVAPI32.dll!RegSetValueExA
0x546824.reason: Windows registry import; cases observe the key handle, value name, REG_SZ type, string bytes and byte count, and script the status without touching the system registry.

0x546820.name: ADVAPI32.dll!RegDeleteValueA
0x546820.reason: Windows registry import; cases observe the key handle and value name and script the status without touching the system registry.

0x546830.name: ADVAPI32.dll!RegCloseKey
0x546830.reason: Windows registry import reached through a register loaded from its import slot; cases observe each closed handle and script the status.

notes: Boundary reviewed against the hash-checked v1.0 disassembly. Object layout shared with application_configuration: +0x00 open flag, +0x08/+0x0c/+0x10 parent key handles, +0x14 base key, +0x18 selected key. 0x4b5df0 is thiscall with (value name, string) and returns 1 only on RegSetValueExA success, 0 when closed or either pointer is null; the byte count includes the terminator. 0x4b5f80 is thiscall with (value name) and returns 1 only on RegDeleteValueA success; a null name returns the null argument itself (0). 0x4b5d70 clears the open flag and closes +0x08, +0x0c, +0x10, then +0x14 only when it differs from +0x18, then +0x18; a closed object does nothing. Results of RegCloseKey are ignored.
